messages:
Ava: Hey team - need to swap my Fri 18:00-22:00 oncall shift. Flight got moved to later and I won't make the start. Can anyone take it? I can do a 30m pairing handoff + run the prewarm script before I leave. :airplane:

Jon: I can take the shift if someone can walk me through the prewarm steps and any special risk notes for the weekend rollout.

Ava: Awesome, thanks @Jon. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall. Quick prewarm command I use: `./scripts/prewarm_cache.sh --models all --tokens 2048` — check `/var/log/redwood/prewarm.log` for errors. Heads-up: low-risk model rollout scheduled Fri 17:30 UTC (v2.14 canary -> prod). Watch for latency blips and reranker 500s.

Priya: I can overlap 18:00-19:00 to do handoff + shadowing if that helps. @Jon do you want me to stay the first hour?

Jon: Yes please @Priya, that'd be great. Also, do I need any extra console permissions?

Ava: You should already have console access. If not, ping @Taylor. Also export AWS profile `redwood-oncall` before running the prewarm script, and run inside tmux.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary/rollout v2.14 -> production at 2026-03-20T17:30Z (automated). Monitor /dash/models for latency and error-rate alerts.

Taylor: I have org access. @Jon confirm you can SSH to `oncall-1.redwood` — if not I can add a key and push it to your profile.

Jon: SSH is fine from my laptop. Quick Q: do we need to prewarm the KV cache separately? I remember a step for embeddings.

Ava: Yes, run `python tools/prewarm_kv.py --batch 50` (roughly 5-7min). Start it in tmux and tail the log. If prewarm fails, fallback is to pour traffic to `dedicated-fallback-a` and escalate to infra@.

Marco: I can take the 22:00-02:00 slot if someone covers 18:00-22:00. Happy to be on-call late if needed.

Jon: I'll take 18:00-22:00 then. @Marco thanks — please confirm you can take my phone number for escalation (DM preferred).

Ava: Thanks everyone — I'll DM @Jon the short checklist + the prewarm commands and the keys. I'll also add a one-paragraph handoff note to the runbook page under "Fri swap - Ava -> Jon". :pray:

Taylor: Quick checklist note for the handoff doc: 1) Verify `prewarm_cache` completed with no errors; 2) Check canary metrics (latency & 5xx) for 30m post-deploy; 3) Confirm KV cache hit-rate > 80%.

Priya: Sounds good. I'll stay the first hour to make sure Jon is up to speed.

Ava: Perfect — appreciate you all. Leaving a calendar update now.
